description: Connector *kinds* the organization may connect from Core › Connections — Synapse protocols that exist in this deployment. No instances, no endpoints, no credentials ship in the pack.

kinds.label: PostgreSQL
kinds.description: Read-only or read-write SQL over a governed connection; queries are parameterised.

kinds.label: REST / OpenAPI
kinds.description: Any HTTP API described by an OpenAPI document; operations become tools after review.

kinds.label: MCP server
kinds.description: Model Context Protocol server; its tools are discovered and enabled one by one.

kinds.label: Google Workspace
kinds.description: Gmail · Calendar · Drive through Google's APIs with a user or shared OAuth consent.

kinds.label: Microsoft 365
kinds.description: Outlook · Calendar · OneDrive / SharePoint through Microsoft Graph with an Entra consent.

kinds.label: Files · S3-compatible
kinds.description: Object storage (S3 / MinIO / Azure Blob via S3 gateway) as a governed file source.

kinds.label: Webhook (inbound)
kinds.description: External systems start a flow by calling a signed inbound hook.
